Maladaptive Strategies.value: Situations that make me feel strong emotions
Talking with others about the event or its aftermath
I think about why the event has happened to me

Threat.value: I am unable to relax even when I know I am in a safe place
My body feels constantly tense and ready to react to danger

Memory.value: My memories of the frightening event are very clear and detailed.
The memory feels like it belongs to someone else rather than to me
I find myself pushing the memory away before I can fully recall it

Negative Appraisals.value: I am no longer capable of doing the things that defined me
My body has been permanently damaged by what happened
I can no longer trust my own body

issues.item: Revenge Fantasies: I imagine getting revenge on the people responsible
issues.explanation: For a life-threatening illness trauma, revenge fantasies toward 'people responsible' are hard to reconcile unless there is a clear malpractice/perpetrator framing, which is not otherwise supported by the rest of the profile. The accompanying appraisals focus on institutional failure and bodily damage, but the overall profile centers on illness-related vulnerability rather than interpersonal attack, making this item clinically implausible in this trauma context.

issues.item: Threat in Movements: Sudden movements by others put me immediately on guard
issues.explanation: Hypervigilance to sudden movements by others fits assault/combat-type threat more than life-threatening illness. In this profile, threat is otherwise expressed as generalized danger/need for safety (escape route planning, sleep problems) and memory/appraisals are illness-focused. Sudden movements by others introduces an interpersonal immediate-danger cue that is not coherently linked to the illness trauma formulation.

issues.item: Institutional Failure: The people or institutions that should have protected me let me down
issues.explanation: For a life-threatening illness, 'Institutional Failure' can occur, but in this profile it sits awkwardly alongside the other appraisals, which are centered on bodily damage and lost capability. The set is much more coherent as illness-related self/health appraisals than as a betrayal-by-protectors trauma narrative; this item introduces a different trauma meaning without support from the other nodes.

issues.item: Escape Route Planning: I always identify escape routes before I feel comfortable anywhere
issues.explanation: 'Escape Route Planning' is more typical of danger from external assault, entrapment, or public attack. In a life-threatening illness profile, especially with no trigger items and threat content otherwise focused on generalized hyperarousal, this item is hard to reconcile clinically with the trauma type and the rest of the formulation.
